name: Amayakashi na Kanojo ~Boseiteki na Ayakashi Musume to Ama Ero Seikatsu Hajimemasu~
original_name: アまヤカシな彼女 ～母性的なアヤカシ娘と甘エロ生活はじめます～
source:
Our protagonist, Kuki Kizutaka, has had his body and spirit ruined by a black company. He visits a rural town to recuperate and, by a strange coincidence, he happens to meet some youkai girls and ends up living with them.

According to the girls, the protagonist's semen is precious and can increase youkai's magical power.

In exchange for pampering him, the girls ask for his semen...!

And so begins a naughty slow life with the youkai girls!!

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/amayakasi/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
我们的主人公木冢久贵的身体和精神都被黑公司毁掉了。他前往一个乡村小镇疗养，在一个奇怪的巧合中，他碰巧遇到了一些妖怪女孩，并最终与她们住在一起。

据女孩们说，主角的精液很珍贵，可以增加妖怪的魔力。

为了换取宠爱他，女孩们索要他的精液……！

就这样开始了和妖怪女孩们调皮的慢生活！！

[翻译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/amayakasi/story.html]官网[/url]]
